posts.author: rpm
posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: I am holding substantial qty since 2018. Apparently a large number of retail shareholders who used to be very active on this thread seem to have left. This is sad. In my opinion, this bank has definitely crossed the turnaround point in Q1 and is now on way to its compounder story. This was repeatedly promised by the management only to be tripped first by Covid and then by microfinance loans. Let us keep our fingers crossed for next few quarters. If the bank moves along at the current pace of 20% asset growth, price should cross into 3 figures by April. Bank has structurally transformed as plan…
